kultivator.sects.meditation_bonus: Meditating beside your sect mate %s, your qi flows more smoothly (cultivation ×1.15).
kultivator.sects.help.create: /sect create <name> – found your own sect and become its Sect Master
kultivator.sects.help.invite: /sect invite <player> – invite a disciple (Sect Master only, valid 5 minutes)
kultivator.sects.help.join: /sect join <name> – join a sect that invited you
kultivator.sects.help.leave: /sect leave – leave your sect (a Sect Master hands the sect to the oldest member)
kultivator.sects.help.kick: /sect kick <player> – expel a member (Sect Master only)
kultivator.sects.help.disband: /sect disband – dissolve your sect (Sect Master only, repeat to confirm)
kultivator.sects.help.info: /sect info [name] – about your sect or another one
kultivator.sects.help.list: /sect list – every sect of this world
kultivator.sects.help.chat: /sect chat <message> – speak to your online sect mates
kultivator.sects.help.spar: /sect spar <player> – challenge someone nearby to a friendly sparring match
kultivator.sects.help.spar_answer: /sect spar accept | decline – answer a sparring challenge
kultivator.sects.help.footer: Click a line to put the command into the chat box. Meditating near a sect mate gives ×1.15 cultivation.
